description: EXAMPLE ONLY -- illustrates the fintr_study_spec_v1 schema; not a recommendation and not a validated finding. Tests whether a day where the single largest-magnitude broker's AKD net is a large share of that day's implied AKD volume proxy is followed by a different forward return than the baseline. top1_akd_net_share_of_volume itself rests on the unverified daily_market_proxy hypothesis documented in fintr.features.period (label derived_proxy_not_official_ohlc).
